services_about.title: About us
services_about.body:
Baywatch Travel was born in Casamicciola Terme, in the heart of Ischia, with the goal of offering a complete, tailor-made incoming tourism service.

We handle everything: airport and port transfers, hotel bookings, guided excursions, food and wine experiences, and thermal spa itineraries. We work with a handpicked network of local partners to guarantee quality, authenticity, and attention to every detail.

Whether it's a romantic weekend in Capri or a cultural tour through Rome and Tuscany, our team builds every itinerary by truly listening to what you need.

destinations.hero_subtitle: Hidden gems and iconic landmarks of the Mediterranean.

descriptions.ischia: Steaming thermal waters, lush gardens, and the Aragonese Castle rising from the sea.
descriptions.capri: Legendary sea stacks, the Blue Grotto, and an elegance that never goes out of style.
descriptions.procida: Pastel-coloured houses, fishing boats, and slow rhythms, a daydream come to life.
descriptions.napoli: Pizza, alleyways, Vesuvius on the horizon: a city you breathe in deeply.
descriptions.sorrento: Scented lemons, gulf terraces, and a sweetness that stays with you.
descriptions.amalfi: An ancient maritime republic, postcard views, and a sea that looks painted on.
descriptions.pompei: A Roman city frozen in time, under the silent gaze of Vesuvius.
descriptions.sicilia: Greek temples, baroque towns, a smoking Etna. An island that is already a journey.
descriptions.sardegna: Crystal waters, hidden coves, and a wild hinterland to explore.
descriptions.roma: Two thousand years of history around every corner. The Eternal City still surprises.
descriptions.toscana: Golden hills, cypresses, medieval villages, and wines that tell of the land.
descriptions.positano: Perched on the cliffside, sun-kissed beaches, and the dolce vita you didn’t expect.
